writing:fc:32.hint: AもBも両方ともない、という否定の表現は何か。
writing:fc:32.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:32.answer: without saying a word or looking back
choices: without saying a word or looking back
writing:fc:32.fullSentence: He left without saying a word or looking back.
writing:fc:32.explanation: withoutの後にAもBもない状態を並べる。

writing:fc:33.hint: 道に迷ってどこにいるか分からなくなる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:33.question: We _____ in the old town.
writing:fc:33.fullSentence: We lost our way in the old town.
writing:fc:33.explanation: 迷子になるという意味。

writing:fc:34.hint: 複数の人に次々質問して情報を集める、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:34.question: I _____ to find a good doctor.
writing:fc:34.fullSentence: I asked around to find a good doctor.

writing:fc:35.hint: 直接会って話す、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:35.question: It is better to _____ about this matter.
writing:fc:35.fullSentence: It is better to talk face to face about this matter.
writing:fc:35.explanation: 対面で話すという意味。

writing:fc:36.hint: 時代の変化についていけず古くなってしまう、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:36.question: Some traditional customs have _____.
writing:fc:36.fullSentence: Some traditional customs have fallen behind the times.
writing:fc:36.explanation: 時代に取り残されるという意味。

writing:fc:37.hint: 体重が増える、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:37.question: He _____ after eating fast food every day.
writing:fc:37.fullSentence: He gained weight after eating fast food every day.

writing:fc:38.hint: 限られた収入内でうまく生活を成り立たせる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:38.question: It is hard to _____ on such a small salary.
writing:fc:38.fullSentence: It is hard to make ends meet on such a small salary.
writing:fc:38.explanation: 収入内でやりくりするという意味。

writing:fc:39.hint: 他人からの信頼を得る、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:39.question: It takes time to _____ of your colleagues.
writing:fc:39.fullSentence: It takes time to gain the trust of your colleagues.
writing:fc:39.explanation: 信頼を得るという意味。

writing:fc:40.hint: 自分の仕事をうまくやり遂げる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:40.question: She _____ her job every day.
writing:fc:40.fullSentence: She does well at her job every day.
writing:fc:40.explanation: 仕事などをうまくやるという意味。

writing:fc:41.hint: 大学に入学することを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:41.question: It is his dream to _____ next year.
writing:fc:41.fullSentence: It is his dream to get into college next year.
writing:fc:41.explanation: 大学に入るという意味。

writing:fc:42.hint: 移動して場所を変える、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:42.question: It is convenient to _____ by bike in this city.
writing:fc:42.fullSentence: It is convenient to get around by bike in this city.

writing:fc:43.hint: たまたま、思いがけず何かをする、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:43.question: I _____ my old friend on the train.
writing:fc:43.fullSentence: I happened to meet my old friend on the train.

writing:fc:44.hint: 全く知らない人、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:44.question: She helped _____ who had fallen down.
writing:fc:44.fullSentence: She helped a total stranger who had fallen down.

writing:fc:45.hint: 電車の中で自分の降りるべき駅を通り過ぎてしまう、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:45.question: I was so tired that I _____.
writing:fc:45.fullSentence: I was so tired that I missed my station.
writing:fc:45.explanation: 自分の駅を過ぎてしまうという意味。

writing:fc:46.hint: 面白い話をして人を笑わせる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:46.question: He always _____ to cheer people up.
writing:fc:46.fullSentence: He always tells a joke to cheer people up.
writing:fc:46.explanation: 冗談を言うという意味。

writing:fc:47.hint: あることを心から好んでいる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:47.question: She _____ classical music.
writing:fc:47.fullSentence: She is fond of classical music.
writing:fc:47.explanation: 好んでいるという意味。

writing:fc:48.hint: 口コミによって評判が広まる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:48.question: The restaurant became famous by _____.
writing:fc:48.fullSentence: The restaurant became famous by word of mouth.

writing:fc:49.hint: 花粉症の症状に悩まされている状態を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:49.question: He _____ every spring.
writing:fc:49.fullSentence: He has hay fever every spring.
writing:fc:49.explanation: 花粉症にかかっているという状態。

writing:fc:50.hint: 何かに強い興味を持ち、はまっている、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:50.question: My brother _____ video games these days.
writing:fc:50.fullSentence: My brother is really into video games these days.
writing:fc:50.explanation: 何かに夢中であるという意味。

writing:fc:51.hint: 法的・社会的に成人として認められる年齢になる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:51.question: In Japan, people _____ at eighteen.
writing:fc:51.fullSentence: In Japan, people come of age at eighteen.
writing:fc:51.explanation: 成人になるという意味。

writing:fc:52.hint: 困難な状況を乗り越え、それを克服する、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:52.question: It took months for him to _____ the difficult times.
writing:fc:52.fullSentence: It took months for him to get through the difficult times.
writing:fc:52.explanation: 困難を乗り越えるという意味。

writing:fc:53.hint: 実際の現場で経験を積む、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:53.question: Students can _____ through internships.
writing:fc:53.fullSentence: Students can gain practical experience through internships.
writing:fc:53.explanation: 実践的な経験を積むという意味。

writing:fc:54.hint: 他人と自分の考えを述べ合う、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:54.question: We _____ about the new policy.
writing:fc:54.fullSentence: We exchanged opinions about the new policy.
writing:fc:54.explanation: 意見を交換するという意味。

writing:fc:55.hint: 何も考えずただそれだけを繰り返す、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:55.question: He _____ about his job.
writing:fc:55.fullSentence: He does nothing but complain about his job.

writing:fc:56.hint: 他人と円満な関係を築いて過ごす、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:56.question: It is important to _____ your coworkers.
writing:fc:56.fullSentence: It is important to get along with your coworkers.
writing:fc:56.explanation: うまくやっていくという意味。
